style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 3 Vikula Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: Drawing influence from the shifting tones of a winter sea, the Vikula baubles blend teal, blue, along with silver in a layered, seafoam finish. Their surface has an antiqued mercury-glass effect, creating soft patina and depth. This result is a distinctive ornament that feels both cool and luminous, ideal for adding a subtle shimmer to festive settings. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade. Dimensions(mm): Height: 100. Width: 100. Depth: 100 This Cushion has Fill.
